IRMA positional data reference

Generated from output_schema.yaml

IRMA_positional_data.Rmd

Processed GLS data with missing locatations interpolated based on the Informed Random Movement Algorithm (IRMA)

  • id

    type: string

    Unique ID of position

  • date_time

    type: Date time at which position was recorded

  • logger_id

    type: integer

    Unique internal identfier of the logger

  • logger_model

    type: string

    GLS logger model (e.g., c65, mk4083, etc.).

  • year_tracked

    type: string

    Duration that the individual was instrumented with a logger (e.g. 2015_17).

  • session_id

    type: string

    Unique ID for the logger deployment session during which this data was recorded.

  • individ_id

    type: string

    Unique ID for each individual.

  • deployment_date

    type: date

    Date when the logger was deployed.

  • retrieval_date

    type: date

    Date when the logger was retrieved.

  • ring_number

    type: string

    Metal ID ring number.

  • country_code

    type: string

    Country/local code for metal ring.

  • species

    type: string

    English name of the species.

  • colony

    type: string

    Name of the colony where the logger was deployed and retrieved. Note that a SEATRACK colony name can cover several locations

  • col_lon

    type: float

    Longitude of the colony.

  • col_lat

    type: float

    Latitude of the colony.

  • loc_type

    type: string

    Either GLS or IRMA, indicates whether this point is part of the original GLS positional data or generated by IRMA.

  • lon

    type: float

    Longitude of position

  • lat

    type: float

    Latitude of positon

  • sex

    type: string

    Recorded sex at trapping event.

  • age_deployment

    type: string

    Age of the bird at the time of deployment.

  • age_class_irma

    type: string

    age_deployment reclassifed to be either “A” for an adult or “C” otherwise.

  • data_responsible

    type: string

    Data owner or responsible person.

  • data_version

    type: integer

    Version of the processing script used.
